semantics.identity_rule: Each Event type has explicit identity/version.
semantics.meaning_rule: Event meaning is stable under compatible identity.
semantics.occurrence_rule: Type definition is separate from each Event occurrence.
semantics.authority_rule: Event type definition never authorizes downstream effects.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant identity, type, relation, state and meaning are explicit and never inferred solely from display text, path, layout, file order, timestamp or implementation accident.
Resolved, projected, indexed, cached, formatted or derived representations never become source-of-truth or authority merely because they are convenient or available.

hard_gates.condition: new payload meaning breaks old type silently
